ov: أرضي بفلفلها الحلو (بالإنجليزية:My Sweet Pepper Land) فيلم للمخرج الكردي «هينر سليم».
plotEn: In a remote village in Iraqi Kurdistan lives the Kurdish patriot Baran who since recently serves as a policeman. He cannot help but provoke the local villain Aziz Aga and finds himself supported by an attractive lady named Govend who works as a teacher.
